description: This file is a Makefile fragment used in the OpenWrt build system for package management. It defines macros and rules to generate package installation scripts, handle dependencies, provides, and package metadata for OpenWrt packages, integrating with different package formats like ipk and apk.

methods.name: description_escape
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a description string for safe inclusion.

methods.name: gen_package_wildcard
methods.description: Generates a wildcard pattern for package files based on package name and architecture settings.

methods.name: maybe_use_xargs
methods.description: Runs a command with arguments, using xargs if arguments count exceeds a threshold.

methods.name: remove_ipkg_files
methods.description: Removes a set of ipkg package files corresponding to a package name and candidate files.

methods.name: BuildPackVariable
methods.description: Defines a package build variable and exports it, based on package info.

methods.name: FixupReverseDependencies
methods.description: Fixes reverse dependency links for a package.

methods.name: FixupDependencies
methods.description: Fixes dependency links for a package.

methods.name: FormatDepends
methods.description: Formats dependency lists, handles version constraints and ABI suffixes.

methods.name: AddProvide
methods.description: Adds provide entries with optional ABI suffixes and versions.

methods.name: SanitizeProvides
methods.description: Filters out self and certain virtual provides from the provide list.

methods.name: FormatProvides
methods.description: Formats the provides field, adding ABI and version info where applicable.

methods.name: GetProviderPriority
methods.description: Determines package priority for provider selection, giving higher priority to default variants and ABI versions.

methods.name: CheckDependencies
methods.description: Checks whether package dependencies are satisfied, generating a list of missing libraries.
